name: id
description: The ID of the do and don't list component.

name: heading
description: Heading to be displayed on the do and don't list component.

params.name: text
params.description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text for the heading. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML for the heading. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: visuallyHiddenText
params.description: A visually hidden suffix added to the heading.

params.name: classes
params.description: Classes to add to the heading.

params.name: attributes
params.description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the heading.

name: icon
description: Optional icon modifier for the do and don't list items – `"cross"` or `"tick"`. Defaults to `"tick"`.

name: items
description: Array of do and don't items objects.

params.name: text
params.description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text to use within each do and don't item. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML to use within each do and don't item. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

name: prefixText
description: Optional prefix text used before each do and don't item. Defaults to `"do not"` when `type` is `"cross"`.

name: hidePrefix
description: If set to `true`, the optional `prefixText` will be removed from each do and don't item.

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the do and don't list container.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the do and don't list container.
